mapper.select: SELECT MIN(curr.id) AS category_id, curr.category AS category_code, SUM(curr.amount) AS amount, CASE WHEN prev.prev_amount IS NULL OR prev.prev_amount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(ROUND(((SUM(curr.amount) - prev.prev_amount) * 100.0) / prev.prev_amount) AS SIGNED) END AS comparison_rate, CAST(ROUND((SUM(curr.amount) * 100.0) / NULLIF(total.total_amount, 0)) AS SIGNED) AS expense_rate FROM service_record curr CROSS JOIN ( SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM service_record WHERE YEAR(record_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(record_date) = #{month} ) total LEFT JOIN ( SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS prev_amount FROM service_record WHERE record_date >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND record_date < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY category ) prev ON curr.category = prev.category WHERE YEAR(curr.record_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(curr.record_date) = #{month} GROUP BY curr.category, prev.prev_amount, total.total_amount
